baseline: post-promotion signature matrix (attitude_gravity_mag already in imu0_bias_drift)
provenance: generalised from the WP-C2 Part 3 control: the same GPS relation repairs gps_fault+nominal when ungated and repairs nothing when gated by gvalid
rule: a feature intended to discriminate hypothesis h must not be gated by any gate that h closes
severity_note: A violation is fatal to the hypothesis exactly when the violating feature is its SOLE feature: the hypothesis then has an empty effective signature and is absorbed into nominal. A violation on one of several features merely weakens the hypothesis.
